fusions.name: Gnawing Filings
fusions.desc: Looses a swirl of iron filings that deals 6 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 20% chance to leave each [Sundered] for 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Picked Clean
fusions.desc: Sends a knot of iron filings into an enemy, dealing 18 damage and using up every affliction you have on it for 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Cloud of Filings
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a cloud of iron filings for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each bite has a 25% chance to leave it [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Stripped to Plate
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
